messages:
marco: PR opened to update Atlas-Opt-3B model card: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1760. Changes: clarify supported variants (full / opt-q4), update limits table, add a short migration note for SDK v3, include Python + JS snippets for batched embeddings and streaming generate, and fix a couple of broken links.

ivy: thanks — can you paste the limits/bench rows you're proposing?

marco: current draft table below:
```
variant | seq_limit | recommended_shards | notes
Atlas-Opt-3B-full | 4096 | ~1 shard per 70 QPS | measured avg prompt=48 tokens
Atlas-Opt-3B-opt-q4 | 4096 | ~1 shard per 55 QPS | q4 perf drop ~18-25% on A10G
```

rahul: LGTM but change "~1 shard per 70 QPS" to "~1 shard per 70 QPS (estimate; size for peak)" — customers often size to average and get surprises. Also add a short KV cache note for long contexts.

ivy: for the q4 line, suggest wording: "Quantized (opt-q4) variants typically reduce throughput ~18-25% depending on batch size; test with representative prompts." Add bench link: https://bench.redwood/runs/1760-atlas.

marco: added bench link and wording adjustment. Draft snippets below — please sanity-check: 
```python
# Python batched embeddings (SDK v2/v3 compatible: batch param name note)
from redwood import Client
c = Client()
# v2: batch_size=16, v3: batchSize=16
res = c.embeddings.create(model='atlas-opt-3b-full', input=['a','b','c'], batch_size=16)
print(len(res))
```
```javascript
// JS streaming generate (SDK v3 async iterator pattern)
import Redwood from '@redwood/sdk'
const client = new Redwood()
for await (const chunk of client.generate.stream({ model: 'atlas-opt-3b-full', prompt: 'Summarize:' })) {
  process.stdout.write(chunk.text)
}
```

rahul: small edits: use camelCase in JS example for consistency (already done), and in Python snippet add comment recommending "max_tokens_per_item" hint when batching long items. Also change batch param comment to be explicit: "SDK v2: batch_size, SDK v3: batchSize".

marco: updated. I also fixed two broken anchors: /docs/embedding/shard-guide -> /docs/guides/sharding-estimates and /docs/streams -> /docs/usage/streaming. Preview?

docs-preview-bot: preview deployed  https://deploy-preview.redwood-inference.io/docs/model-cards/atlas-opt-3b (status: success) :white_check_mark:

ivy: quick nit: add a one-liner in migration tips: "If you rely on batch_size in automation, update to batchSize for SDK v3 and validate behavior under autoscaling."

rahul: approve from docs side after that blurb.

marco: added migration blurb and a changelog line. Merging shortly if no objections.

ivy: approved.

marco: merged. changelog: "Atlas-Opt-3B model card: clarified variants and shard sizing, added SDK v3 snippets (Python/JS), migration tips, updated bench links and fixed anchor links."

docs-preview-bot: prod sync complete  docs updated at /model-cards/atlas-opt-3b :rocket:
